title: Data structures and algorithmic thinking — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: A support queue needs fast lookups and prioritized work.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What precondition does binary search require?

options.text: Data sorted under the search ordering

questions.explanation: Without a consistent sorted order its comparisons cannot discard half the search range safely.

questions.prompt: Does iterating a PriorityQueue guarantee sorted output?
questions.explanation: Repeated poll follows priority order; iteration does not.

questions.prompt: Which traversal finds shortest paths in an unweighted graph?
questions.explanation: BFS explores vertices in increasing edge distance.

questions.prompt: What prevents revisiting vertices indefinitely in a cyclic graph?
questions.explanation: Record discovered vertices before revisiting them.

questions.prompt: What is the expected time for a well-distributed hash lookup?
questions.explanation: Hashing aims for constant expected lookup under suitable assumptions.

questions.prompt: What must a terminating recursive routine have?

options.text: A base case and progress toward it

questions.explanation: Without progress or a reachable base case recursion can continue indefinitely.
The heap contains 3, 1, and 2; internal iteration order is not a sorting contract. The minimum 1 is removed. The next minima are 2 and 3.
